params.name: portfolioId
params.description: Id identifying a portfolio to retrieve news for, should not be used with the cusip parameter.

params.name: cusip
params.description: One or more CUSIPs identifying the bonds to retrieve news for, should not be used with the portfolio parameter.

params.name: state
params.description: State to retrieve news for. Must not be used with the cusip or portfolio parameters.

params.name: city
params.description: City to retrieve news for, must be used with the state parameter and not with the cusip or portfolio parameters.

params.name: fips
params.description: FIPS code to retrieve news for, must not be used with the cusip or portfolio parameters.

params.name: sector
params.description: Sector to retrieve news for, must be used with the state parameter and not with the cusip, or portfolio parameters.

params.name: articleType
params.description: One or more types of articles (i.e., News, PressRelease) to return. By default all types are returned.

params.name: text
params.description: Keyword or phrase to search for news when not using a portfolio

params.name: startDate
params.description: News date to start from. Format is yyyy-mm-dd for daily news or yyyy-mm-dd'T'HH:mm if you want it down to the hour or minute. Should not be used if offset parameter is.

params.name: endDate
params.description: News date to end with. Format is yyyy-mm-dd for daily (inclusive) news or yyyy-mm-dd'T'HH:mm if you want it down to the hour or minute. If startDate is used and endDate is not the default endDate is today.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of days back news should be returned for. Should not be used with startDate. Default is 31.

params.name: tz
params.description: Timezone used in startDate and endDate.

params.name: dateType
params.description: Indicates whether dates to query by should be published dates "published" or available dates (processing completed) "available". Default is published.

params.name: pageNo
params.description: Page number of the total result set to return, default is 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results out of the total result set per page to return, default is 100, maximum is 1000.

params.name: significance
params.description: Significance of articles to return, possible values are "HIGH" and "MEDIUM", default is "HIGH". The parameter is a threshold so a value of MEDIUM will return MEDIUM and HIGH significance articles.

params.name: includeCusips
params.description: Return ALL CUSIPs affected by the article. This option requires a verified CUSIP license.

items.docs:
Provides the ability to search for news relevant to municipal bonds. The search criteria used when querying news includes the following options: 
 * CUSIP - Querying by CUSIP returns only news articles where the identified bond is somehow affected by the subject matter of an article.
 * Portfolio - A portfolio is made up of one or more CUSIPs. Querying by portfolio returns only news articles where any of the bonds in the portfolio are affected by the subject matter of an article. This option can

Provides an advanced municipal news search capability. The search criteria used when querying news includes a more advanced approach to identifying locations, sections, and a larger number of cusips. The following are the options supported for searching the news: 
 * CUSIP - Querying by CUSIP returns only news articles where the identified bond is somehow affected by the subject matter of an article. Up to 10000 CUSIPs can be queried. 
 * Portfolio - A portfolio is made up of one or more CUSIPs.
